comparator.name: General Cultural Studies (Algemene Cultuurwetenschappen)
comparator.sourceNotes: The OU programme page confirms a 180-EC part-time Dutch-taught BA with a 60-EC propedeuse and 120-EC postpropedeuse, four main themes (Diversity and inclusion; Digital transitions in cultural heritage; Technology, media and culture; Stigma, health and culture) and no formal routes. The 2026-27 study guide (BD476) and annual schedule list the courses, each 5 EC unless stated: twelve propedeuse courses (introductory course, six thematic/portal-type courses, four method courses, Academic writing), four themed postpropedeuse course sets, further electives (Stage 10 EC, Onderzoeksontwikkelingen en -vaardigheden 10 EC), and a 15-EC Bachelor graduation trajectory or thesis practicum. The study guide's schematic table, however, gives component sizes (introduction 5, methods 4x = 20, portal courses 4x = 20, academic writing 5; theme blocks 45, choice block 30, free space 30, skills block 15, graduation 15) that sum to 185 EC rather than 180, with a 50-EC propedeuse against the stated 60, and the annual schedule lists six rather than four portal-type courses. The guide does not state which courses form each theme block or the skills block, and the 2026-27 programme-specific education and examination regulations that would settle these points could not be found; the only accessible regulation is the general 2025-26 bachelor OER, which defers the curriculum and free-space size to the programme-specific part. No unverified component credits are supplied.

exception.reason: Current official OU sources do not establish a consistent 180-EC pathway for 2026-27. The study guide's component table totals 185 EC and contradicts both the 60-EC propedeuse and the six portal-type courses in the annual schedule; the split of the 45 EC left between choice block and free space, the membership of the theme blocks and the make-up of the 15-EC skills block are not stated, and the programme-specific OER that would resolve them was not accessible. Fixing a 180-EC route would require guessing which figures are correct, so no canonical comparison is published.
exception.curriculumContext: Supported: 180 EC; 60-EC propedeuse of twelve 5-EC courses in the annual schedule; postpropedeuse with at least three of four theme blocks (themes named above), a mandatory skills block, a choice block, free space of at least 15 EC under the general OER, and a 15-EC graduation trajectory (CB9806) or thesis practicum (CB9906) linked to the theme blocks. Unresolved: exact EC of the choice block and free space, theme-block membership, skills-block composition and which propedeuse courses are compulsory. Resolve the 2026-27 programme-specific OER curriculum before revisiting this target.
exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Reviewed all 151 course rows of current GitHub main data/reference/ucr_courses_enriched.xlsx. UCR offers substantial related humanities study, for example GOSHIST111 Modern History, GOSHIST112 Histories of Gender, GOSPHIL111 Introduction to Western Philosophy, MCCLITR111 Introduction to Literary Studies, MCCHEAM111 Introduction to Western Art History, MCCHEAM312 Modern Art & Modern Museums, MCCMEDI111 Introduction to Film & Media, MCCMEDI211 From T.V. to TikTok and MCCMEDI311 Media & Race, so a defensible closest-match programme may well exist. The exception rests on the unresolved external curriculum, not on a lack of UCR coverage, and no UCR alternative is encoded.
